The '''T-65C-A2 X-wing starfighter''' or simply the '''T-65C-A2 X-wing''' was a model of space superiority [[starfighter]] in use by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]], part of the versatile [[X-wing starfighter]] line.<ref name="UVG" /> [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]] used at least one at the [[Battle of Scarif|Battle]] of [[Scarif]] in [[1 BBY]]. By [[5 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> the T-65C was considered an older model, but one was used by [[Temmin Wexley]] as part of the [[New Republic]]'s [[Phantom Squadron]] in the [[Battle of Jakku|Battle]] of [[Jakku]].<ref name="Empire's End" />
